_comment: ERAN v2 AUDIO — OVERFIT FIX config (Iddo, 2026-07-09). The v1 config.json trained a ~25M-param model (n_layer 8, n_embd 512) on only ~63 min / 568K tokens of audio -> it MEMORIZED (loss 0.10 / ppl 1.1) and babbles mush. This v2 shrinks the brain (~3.6M params) and trains on a MUCH larger token cache (tokens_cache_full.npy, built from the full ~19h samples collection) with stronger dropout + weight decay, so tokens >> params and it must GENERALIZE instead of memorize. NON-DESTRUCTIVE: separate cache file + separate checkpoints_v2/ dir; the live v1 trainer and config.json are untouched.
_model_note: SMALLER brain on PURPOSE. n_layer 4 / n_embd 256 -> ~3.6M params (vs ~25M). dropout 0.2 (vs 0.1). With ~6-10M tokens of real heard audio this gives ~2-3 tokens/param instead of the old 0.02 -> memorization is no longer trivially possible.
